protocol: A1 then B2 then A1_repeat: three fresh server processes; only prompt-cache-size changes. Each arm repeats one airport-office-airport development scenario three times, retaining all nine turn observations.

definitions.timing_origin: Final user text submission, not speech end. Responses are text callbacks; no audio produced. Planner/responder durations are individual client request wall times.
definitions.cold_split: Only repeat1/turn1 is fresh_server_first_turn. All other eight turns are retained as later turns. Fresh process is not cold OS/filesystem/Metal state.
definitions.percentiles: Nearest-rank ceil(p*n), matching existing navigation summary. Descriptive small samples, not population estimates.
definitions.prefill: Server progress totals are tokens remaining after nearest-prefix cache retrieval, not full prompt lengths or directly returned API cached_tokens. Requests alternate planner then responder; all18 per-arm sequences finish their logged prefill.
definitions.memory: RSS is sampled server-process RSS; system available memory and swap include every process. macOS available is psutil free+inactive estimate. No server MLX peak or simultaneous STT/TTS workload was measured.

integrity.model_weight_verification: Harness reports full frozen file checks before/after every arm; this post-hoc review did not reread model weights or run inference.

effect_and_response_review.all_observed_effect_sequences: Each independent case starts airport, replaces it with office, then legitimately returns to airport; navigation versions1,2,3 and no stops.
effect_and_response_review.grounding: Airport replies identify the successful destination and first-turn ETA88min; office replies state active route,11.8km and29min; return replies identify airport and actual routeR3. These match simulated tool results, not verified road conditions. Acknowledgments are scored separately from substantive text.

mechanism_evidence.summary: First planner prefill1765 tokens in every arm. At repeat1/turn2, A1 and A1_repeat process2006 remaining tokens while B2 processes272. At repeat2/turn1, one-entry arms process1761 while B2 processes27. This aligns with preservation of both planner and responder prefixes; it is stronger evidence than latency alone.

installed_source_reference.meaning: fetch_nearest_cache yields rest and stream_generate receives that remainder.

comparison.interpretation: The two-entry arm reduces later-turn latency for this fixed alternating workload; returning to one entry restores slower timing. No initial-request improvement is observed. This does not establish a general2x conversational speedup.

recommendation.reason: Consistent A/B/A latency separation plus reduced remaining prefill with identical model requests, outputs, effects and factual delivered text justifies a narrowly scoped launch change.
recommendation.scope: Tested pinned Qwen8B MLX seeded sequential server and one repeated text navigation scenario. Monitor memory during the subsequent actual audio/STT/TTS run; do not infer concurrent capacity or a production memory bound.
recommendation.byte_budget_limitation: Installed mlx-lm0.31.3 seeded _serve_single bypasses --prompt-cache-bytes; the unchanged268435456 flag is nominal only. Logged cache reaches0.38GB for A and0.68GB for B. Do not describe either as enforcing256MiB.
recommendation.memory_interpretation: Similar sampled RSS peaks do not prove zero additional memory cost: cache accounting grows, system available RAM varies, and about4.33GB of swap was already occupied. Swap traffic/system load cannot be attributed to cache count from these measurements.

limitations: One B process between two A processes; three cases per arm and27 turns overall reuse the same scenario and server caches. They are not27 independent trials or a broad accuracy evaluation.
Fixed A/B/A order, background applications, thermal state and shared OS/filesystem/Metal caches remain confounds. No confidence interval or significance claim is justified.
Server startup/model-list readiness is not inference evidence. First-case text timings exclude launcher startup and may include residual initialization; first turns are preserved separately.
No live speech, recognition, synthesis, acoustic barge-in, microphone echo, held-out benchmark, or sustained multiroom capacity was measured.
Substantive text callbacks do not measure first streamed token or audible onset. The simulated route calculation adds about2.5s per turn.
RSS sampling can miss peaks and does not identify total unified-memory consumption. Available/swap measurements include unrelated system activity; the machine was already using substantial swap.
